name: Make payment-failed alert integration deadline time-independent
description: The integration fixture hard-codes periodEndAt to 2026-08-01, so its expected current-access billing card became expired on that date and now deterministically blocks unrelated strict-green PRs.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Replace the fixed 2026-08-01 period-end fixture with a deadline derived relative to the test run and assert against that exact derived ISO value. 2. Preserve the test intent: payer self-scope receives the highest-priority past-due billing card with current access before the derived deadline, while child self-scope receives no billing card. 3. Record red evidence from GitHub Actions runs 30653298824 and 30687802948, then prove the focused real-database integration test and both normal and IDENTITY_V2_ENABLED CI lanes green after the fix. 4. No production billing, access-resolution, notification, database-schema, or environment behavior changes.
riskImpact: P1 because the deterministic date rollover blocks every API-changing PR from satisfying the armed merge gate.
